newsitem.title: GREECE: COURT INVESTIGATOR HEARS TESTIMONY ON BOURSE SCANDAL.
newsitem.headline: COURT INVESTIGATOR HEARS TESTIMONY ON BOURSE SCANDAL.

text.p: Investigating magistrate Costas Ganietsos heard testimony by retail shareholders association president Dimitris Karagounis on the bourse scandal that closed the Athens stock exchange for three days, court sources said.
Ganietsos was then scheduled to hear testimony by broker Alexander Moraitakis, managing director of Nuntius Securities.

"I will reveal everything I know on the matter. I believe that the truth will shine at the end. As members of the stock exchange we are being harmed by its credibility crisis," Moraitakis told Reuters.
Court sources also said that the investigating magistrate would hear testimony by Athens bourse president Manolis Xanthakis around 1900 local. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
